name: button
useFor: Use one default key per view for the action that moves the task forward (Find sites), with `arrow` for a forward action. Use outline for the actions beside it and for icon keys (size icon, always with aria-label), ghost for a low-weight action inside content (add `arrow` when it goes somewhere), secondary for a quiet key in a toolbar or on a dark ground, destructive for the one destructive action in a dialog, and link for an action inside text. Set `loading` while the action runs: the key keeps its size and ignores clicks. Use size sm (32px) for the chat Ask key and dense rows.
constraints: A hatch, outline, shadow or size change on hover
An arrow or icon that moves on hover
A spinner other than the Dial or the tick bar
Two Forest keys side by side
source: Figma "UI · Buttons" (442:3): Primary, Secondary, Text and Icon rows in Default, Hover, Loading and Disabled; the chat Ask key (443:464)

title: Button
description: Mireye's keys with the cut corner: the Forest primary (default), the framed secondary (outline, a Forest line on Bone), a Fog key (secondary), the text button (ghost: an 80% Forest label that turns Forest), destructive and link. 36px tall with 16px sides and a 13px medium label; the fill steps once on hover and back at once on press. Loading walks a tick bar, or turns the Dial on icon keys.
